# Frontend: Midnight Village

Flutter (web, iOS, Android), Riverpod with code generation, GoRouter. Start with
`just brief <screen>` or `just brief <area>`: it prints the spec, the owner's words, the rules
of the parts you touch, the files and the tests.

just test-harness                   # Boot the real backend harness, replay the reference games through it (API runner: all of them; UI ...
just record-assets                  # Record the bundled files as the last release's (tool/release_assets.json): run it deliberately when ...
just check-release                  # A web build with no --dart-define must not contain the /debug toolbar

## Traps

- **Bare `flutter test` / `flutter run` is prod** (fails with "Production API_ORIGIN not configured"): pass `--dart-define=ENV=dev` or use the just recipes.
- **Forgot `just gen`**: analyzer errors in `*.g.dart` that look like real bugs.
- **Goldens are Linux only** (`frontend/dart_test.yaml` skips them elsewhere); CI is the source of truth.
- **`MockHttpClient`** lives in `frontend/integration_test/helpers/` (the web integration build cannot
  import out of its root); `frontend/test/helpers/mock_http_client.dart` re-exports it.
- **A native release build needs `PUBLIC_ORIGIN`** (the web app's https origin): without it
  there is no QR code and no Share, so `frontend/tool/build_android.sh` stops and says what to pass
  (`just build-android`). The release keystore in `frontend/android/release-key/` is PUBLIC by the
  owner's decision (its README says why and how to replace it).
- **The scanner is behind `CodeScanner`**: a test or a gallery picture brings its own
  (`frontend/test/helpers/fake_code_scanner.dart`, `TableSetup.pump(scanner:)`), never the plugin.
- **Test fonts**: real Gloock and Figtree are loaded in tests; `Roboto` is a Figtree stand-in.
- **An app left open renews itself, assets are held to the last release, a tool reuses the web
  build**: `frontend/docs/app-rules.md`, "An app left open".

## Server payloads in tests

Every mocked HTTP body and socket event is built from `contract_samples/` and checked against
the samples of its own situation; a request with no mock fails the test; domain objects come
from `FromSample`, never a constructor with made-up values (`fixture_sources_test.dart` fails
any test that goes around this). Night inputs come from recorded samples (`recordedMe`). A test
about malformed input says so (`offContract: true`). After a payload change: `just samples`,
then fix the fixtures that fail.

## The app's rules (one line each; the long form: `frontend/docs/app-rules.md`)

- **The server decides.** Screens show what `/me/` says; `screenFor` is the one server-state to
  screen table; the only local inputs are `LocalSteps`.
- **Taps change what others can see at once, never on the response**, through the one `Outbox`;
  a choose is never sent twice for a turn.
- **Every request a player's tap makes goes through `playerRequest`**, and the tapped control
  shows it (`Pending`); a write outside it does not build. ("Requests")
- **Every place the app waits is `Waiting`**, in the frame of the screen it waits for; a failure
  is one quiet line on the control (`Notice`). ("Waits")
- **A screen's main action never sits silently disabled**: `.locked(onLockedTap:)`,
  `.waiting(reason:)`, or a label that says what to do (`main_button_rule_test.dart`). ("Main buttons")
- **Every fetch a screen depends on heals**: retried with backoff or polled until its reason ends
  (`frontend/lib/core/healing/`).
- **No waits.** Nothing adds a wait, a minimum time or an assumed timer length; "Ready to vote"
  is never locked.
- **Words**: every player-facing string is in `frontend/lib/design_system/copy/`, none in widgets;
  a spec names a copy key, never the words; a change that adds words says why in its pull request.
- **Names are never cut**: they wrap or are set smaller (`FitWords`, `FitLine`), never an ellipsis.
- **Reading floor** (`docs/design/type-audit.md`): body and names 14, labels 12, 7:1 contrast,
  one amber fill per screen, a selection is lift plus outline.
- **One look, two dresses; values from the skin**: build from `frontend/lib/design_system/primitives/`,
  read `context.skin`, `Space`, `Motion`; no literals (`type_guard_test.dart`, `raw_values_test.dart`). ("The dress")
- **Secrets are held, not tapped**: `HoldToReveal` and `HeldFace`; nothing vibrates on a card.
- **Information a player asks for opens as a sheet from the bottom edge** (`showSkinSheet`).

## Screens

<!-- generated by tool/gen_docs.py (screens): run it with --fix, never edit by hand -->
The screens (`AppScreen`, `frontend/lib/features/game/domain/screen_table.dart`): 01 Join, 02 Table, 03 Deck, 04 Your card, 06 Night board, 08 Talk, 09 Vote, 10 End board.
Every state is swept at 360x640, 360x780, 412x915, 411.43x784, 390x844, text at 1.0, 1.3, 1.6
(`sweepSizes`, `sweepScales` in `frontend/test/helpers/screen_sweep.dart`).
GitHub draws every state strict at 360 and 390 wide (`just screens 360 strict`);
`just look <state>` shows one at 412x915; `just handover` draws a change at 412x915, 360x640.
<!-- end generated -->

A screen state is declared once, as a `ScreenEntry` (`frontend/test_screens/catalogue/`): from
it come its picture in `just screens` and its sweep in the tests (nothing cut, overflowing or
overlapping, the main button reachable and 48 to touch). A test presses anything that takes a
tap with `pressLikeAFinger` (`frontend/test/helpers/finger.dart`); a plain `tester.tap` fails.
